text: Central superiority with 3 midfielders (4-3-3/4-2-3-1). Attack the half-spaces behind their wide midfielders. OOP: a compact 4-4-2 or a 4-1-4-1 covering both strikers with 2 centre-backs + a DM.
The AMC is the threat: Stopping CB, Screening DM, or a tight-marking OI. Their two pivots can be pressed with two men (4-4-2 OOP with the AM pressing).
Decide where you want superiority: the middle (diamond/4-2-2-2) or the flanks (wing-backs). Their full-backs push on — exploit it with a Wide Outlet or Splitting Outlet.
Protect the half-spaces (wide centre-back + wing-back). Their wing-backs give width: Pressing Trap Outside with a Pressing FB. Use your wingers to pin their wing-backs back.
High patience, width, long shots if you have the quality, overload one flank. Counter-press so you are not caught in transition. Low crosses and far-post runs.
It is narrow: Exploit Width, attacking wing-backs/full-backs. OOP: close the middle, let them go wide and defend the cross.
